title: Ordered proper/open factorization of a coefficient mate
statement: For coefficient systems R,S and a compatible coefficient change a:R -> S [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data], and a compactification c=(j,p) [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], the actual compact-support scalar-adjunction mate comparison(a,c) is the proper scalar mate at j!K followed by the S-coefficient proper direct image of the open scalar mate at K, for every K in the ambient derived category. The proper and open mates are the specified maps of [def-pur-finite-compact-support-scalar-data]. This is equality of the canonical maps before inverse limits; it asserts no invertibility, constructibility, finite-extension compatibility or shift normalization.

source.place: Tags 07A6 and 0B56; sites-modules.tex Tag 0E8I. Existing comparison_factorization docstring and proved body.

proof.text: Let alpha be the open restriction square and beta the inverse proper restriction/direct-image square. Expanding the composite restriction identifies beta after alpha with restriction(a,c). Apply Mathlib mateEquiv_vcomp to the three scalar adjunctions, apply its inverse bijection, and evaluate at K. The definitions of comparison, properComparison and openComparison give the displayed identity. This is the existing complete Lean proof, with no use of the later integral coefficient comparison theorem.
